reviewer: Independent AI reviewer with no builder context. Not a human. The generator (build.py), test_laneway.py, verify.py, candidate.json, README.md, evidence/ and integration/ were not opened, and neither were build-report.json or delivery-verification.json.
scope: Repeat holistic, source-locked Gate G architectural-clay review of the exact v007 GLB for vancouver_laneway_house / laneway_garden_studio (variant 3) against the three locked references. It checks both builder-claimed changes, re-tests every open v006 finding, and runs a full regression: a triangle-level diff against v006, pixel diffs of every builder render and board, full-resolution inspection of the matched, whole-building and changed views, and 34 reviewer renders of the exact GLB. The images govern over the catalogue text; per the human ruling the variant is renamed Garage Suite. This review grants no keeper, runtime-activation or publication approval.
recommended_status_note: Architectural-clay independent review passed (Gate G: zero P0 and zero P1). This is not keeper_approved and not a textured-keeper approval. Next checkpoint: an explicit human decision on architectural-clay runtime activation and on the inferred hidden faces. Runtime integration is NOT TESTED.
decision_note: v007 closes the last blocker. The lane ground window and both band slots now have frames 0.01 m into the reveal with glass about 0.045 m behind the face. From the builder's fitted street and oblique cameras they now read as framed windows of the reference widths, not dark slits: first-hit glass is 10.0 of 14.3 px for the ground window and 2.4-2.7 of 5.7-6.5 px for the slots at match_front. The v006 regression is fixed: the upper street-face hairline is gone and the garage-level lining strip remains closed. A triangle-level diff confirms nothing else changed, and the v006 holistic findings still hold: a 2.0 m-ridge hip roof registered to the top view, a glazed corner wrap, a two-riser stoop, complete sides and rear, coherent supports, drainage and grade contact, and no floating parts or visible z-fighting. Eight P2 notes remain, none blocking a student reading of the building. The most visible is that the ground window's interior jamb is exterior cedar, which tints the glass at the grazing street angle. With zero P0 and zero P1 this is an architectural-clay pass. It is not keeper approval, and runtime activation still needs a human.

findings.title: Residual of V6-P1-01: from the street camera, the lane ground window's glass mostly shows its exterior-cedar inner jamb, and the slots read darker than the reference glass
evidence: GLB: ground window cedar face X 7.90, frame X 7.82..7.89, glass X 7.855. The wall jambs, head and sill (Y 0.08 / 0.95, Z 0.95 / 2.45) are CLAY_CEDAR through the full wall X 7.60..7.90, so the 0.235 m of jamb behind the glass line is exterior cedar, not interior finish.

Reviewer ray-casts with the builder's match_front camera through the ground window (pixels 757,490 and 759,470) pass the glass and hit CLAY_CEDAR on the Y 0.95 jamb at X 7.69-7.73. In match_front.png the glass reads as a brown-tan fill inside the black frame (about x 752-768, y 440-530; scratch crops/v7_lane_front.png). In variant_3.png the same window shows reflective glass.

Slots: the inner jambs are CLAY_PANEL (dark), so the slots read as dark glazed slots with frames and sills (match_front.png about x 826-833, y 300-370 and 455-525), against light reflective glass in the reference.

This is not blocking: at the 45-degree front_corner.png (about x 900-945, y 648-780) and in entrance_contact.png and the reviewer's r_groundwin_close.png / r_slot_close.png, both read as glass with the hall behind. Clay glass carries no reflections, which accounts for part of the difference from the photographic references.
findings.required_fix: Give the jamb, head and sill faces behind each frame (X 7.60..7.82 at the ground window, and the slots' inner reveal behind X 7.87) the interior finish (CLAY_INTERIOR), as a real interior return. The street view then sees a light interior reveal through the glass instead of a cedar or panel fill.

findings.title: Faint long-range vertical lines over interior planes on the rear facade and, newly noted, on the lane face
evidence: rear.png (unchanged from v006): 1-px lines at x 721 and 733, y 335-650.

right_side.png (also present in v006 right_side.png, missed in my v006 review): light vertical lines on the lower panel band at about x 780, y 775-910, and on the cedar at about x 733 and 763, y 800-910 (scratch crops/v7_rs_line.png). Reviewer ray-casts at (779-781, 850) hit CLAY_PANEL at X 7.95 first, then interior planes at Y about 3.18-3.20. The ray at (733, 880) hits CLAY_CEDAR at X 7.90, then interior faces at Y 2.70.

In every case the first hit is a closed exterior surface; the lines appear only at the 44-52 m whole-side distances. This is a depth-precision / AO artifact from interior faces seen edge-on, not an envelope crack.

reference_observations: Lock: the three reference hashes match the manifest (fdff5758..., d0913322..., e09ec32b...); the v007 manifest differs from v006 only in the candidate id.
Lane face, street view: a ground window as wide as the corner pane directly above it, two glazed slots near the band's back edge, thin near-flush dark frames, reflective glass.
The references are photographic and show reflections; clay glass is a tinted transparent layer, so the glass will always read darker or show what lies behind it.
positive_observations: Exact building, registered to both fitted reference cameras (eave line, storey datum, garage block, balcony, canopy, porch, panel band, corner box).

Lane face now matches the reference composition at phone scale: corner pane, ground window directly below it at the same width, four-panel band with two framed slots, floor band and downpipe (phone-street.png, phone-oblique.png).

Roof: a closed hip sheet with a 2.0 m ridge (side faces 22.62 degrees, front/back 26.05 degrees), registered to the fitted top view within about 5 px; caps, gutter, soffit, goosenecks and downpipes coherent.
Openings are complete wall sections with frame, glass, sill and room behind on all four faces.
Supports and contacts: post on the two-riser stoop, canopy continuing the floor band, balcony guard and capped cedar end, garden landing, paver apron; nothing below grade.

Texture-free clay: 0 images and 0 textures, 17 materials, 6,748 triangles; bounds X -0.57..8.47, Y -2.7..9.55, Z 0..7.878. Of 680 components, the only bbox-isolated ones are cedar joint strips 6 mm proud. No new coplanar overlaps against v006.
The builder's renders reproduce from this exact GLB (reviewer rerender of rear.png: max 23/255 on 811 of 1,920,000 pixels).
All whole-building views keep grade, footprint and roof in frame with neutral margin.
